=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2581-2598 (PR-state rate-limited branch, zero-wait fall-through) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: After a deadline-capped rate-limit wait that sleeps (wait_seconds > 0), the `continue` at line 2593 correctly returns to the loop top for a fresh PR-state read. But when the wait is capped to zero seconds (deadline already reached), `phase4b_wait_out_rate_limit` does not set `RETRY_READ_AFTER_RATE_LIMIT_WAIT` (line 2340-2342 only sets it when `wait_seconds > 0`). The branch falls through to line 2598, restores the owed-read flag, and proceeds to the run-list and run-status reads without re-reading PR state. If the review run completed during the preceding wait and the PR closed in that same window, the run-status read at line 2682 breaks the loop on `completed`, and the step proceeds to attempt 2 without the `pr_closed_during_retry` guard firing.
  WHY: The loop enters the owed-read iteration (line 2568 condition true because `RETRY_READ_AFTER_RATE_LIMIT_WAIT` was 1 from the prior wait). The PR-state read is still rate-limited. The zero wait clears the flag at line 2586, the helper does not re-set it, and the `continue` at 2593 is not taken. Execution reaches the run reads; a completed run breaks at 2683. Post-loop, `RETRY_RUN_ID` is set and `RETRY_STATUS` is `completed`, so the timeout guard at 2687 is bypassed. Attempt 2 runs against a PR that may have closed during the rate-limit window. The existing test `test_phase4b_rate_limit_until_the_deadline_fails_closed_with_retry_timeout` uses `run_statuses=["in_progress"]` and does not cover a completed run in this zero-wait fall-through; `test_phase4b_pr_closed_during_a_rate_limit_wait_beats_a_completed_run` uses `limited_for=60` (a sleeping wait, not zero), so its `continue` path is different.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
